Name: Sargon
Summary: Sargon was king of Assyria who sent his commander against Ashdod and captured it; Isaiah used the event as a sign of Assyria's coming captivity of Egypt and Ethiopia.
KeyStory: In the year Tartan came to Ashdod, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, Isaiah walked naked and barefoot for three years as a sign against Egypt and Ethiopia.
LifeLesson: God sometimes makes his prophets a living picture of a message people would rather not hear.
